raw_html: [[Poison (enchantment)#Strength Poison, Virulent|Strength Poison, Virulent]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Poison (enchantment)#Strength Poison, Virulent|Strength Poison, Virulent]]: ''' The deadly poison coating this weapon deals one point of strength damage every time it strikes an enemy, and an additional 1 to 6 points of strength damage when it scores a critical hit. Some creatures may be immune or resistant to ability damage.
